title: Book Two · Chapter 195: The Finished Work Sheet
story:
At lunch on Thursday, the trial students meet Miss Wu. She has their work sheets on the public table. A small pile of checked materials is beside them.

Ronan looks at his own four dates. Each has a short note. The first says he checked the current pages. The second says he found the extra copy of packet seven. Packet eleven needed a cover repair.

The third note says he helped with a collection record. The fourth names both students who prepared the box.

Miss Wu gives each student time to read. She does not put them in an order from best to worst.

“The trial work is complete,” she says. “The checked materials are in use. Thank you.”

She reads her notes to Ronan. He found the duplicate packet. He kept the repair copy out of the ready pile. He also left a useful record. His first note put the old pages first. He changed that order. The final version worked.

“Can I keep this?” he asks.

“Yes. The room keeps its own work record.”

He runs a finger down the four dates. This sheet shows things he actually did. Some were alone. Some were with another student or the teacher. The notes say which.

“Is there more work next week?” the other boy asks.

“The trial ends here,” Miss Wu says. “We may open another short period. If we do, the notice will be public again. You can apply then.”

Ronan nods. He wants more work in the room. This opportunity was for four afternoons. Those afternoons are complete now.

Leo and Mei still have the full places. They wait for the trial students to finish. Then they bring their next group packet to Miss Wu. Ronan steps aside and lets them reach the table.

Outside, he folds his own work sheet once. No mark hides inside the fold. All four dates stay on the front.

Jun meets him near the yard.

“Finished?” he asks.

Ronan shows him the sheet. Jun reads the short notes and nods.

“Did you find the missing eleven?”

“Yes. The cover is fixed. A boy collected it for his class.”

“Good.”

Jun asks if Ronan wants to play after lessons. Ronan says yes. He puts the sheet in his bag. Then he walks to the classroom with Jun.

At home, he gives Mum the paper. Dad reads it after dinner. He asks about the joint work. Ronan explains how the girl showed him the problem. She suggested large labels for the piles. He changed the order of his note.

“Her idea helped,” he says.

Dad nods and hands the sheet back.

Ronan puts it in his drawer beside the old practice pages. He keeps both sets. His three old independent results are still there. The trial work is complete too. Mum calls him for the last warm piece of bread. He closes the drawer and goes to the kitchen.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

duplicate＝重复的一份；joint＝共同的；version＝版本；in use＝正在使用。

## 理解问题

1. 四周工作记录怎样体现能力，也准确呈现帮助和合作？
2. 试做结束后，Ronan是否自动得到原来的正式席位或长期任命？

## 读句子

**The final version worked.**

拆开看：The final version / worked.

最后那个版本／起了作用。
